records.issue_text: Subclassing Hash to impersonate I18n.fallbacks only implements the [] method; plugins or Rails upgrades calling defaults, insert, or per-locale mutation (e.g. I18n.fallbacks[:de] = ...) will crash with NoMethodError or TypeError
records.rationale: The finding claims the subclass “only implements the [] method,” but the diff shows it also defines `ensure_loaded!` (`class FallbackLocaleList < Hash ... def ensure_loaded! ... end`). Additionally, since it subclasses `Hash`, it inherits mutation methods like `[]=`/`store`/`default`—so the assertion that per-locale mutation will “crash with NoMethodError or TypeError” isn’t supported by the diff (it may behave unexpectedly because `[]` ignores stored values, but that’s different from crashing).

records.issue_text: FallbackLocaleList Hash subclass silently discards writes: []= and merge! store entries never read back because [] is overridden, so plugin/gem fallback configuration is silently ignored
records.rationale: In `config/initializers/i18n.rb`, `FallbackLocaleList < Hash` overrides `def [](locale)` to always return a computed array (`[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact`). Because it does not override `[]=`/`merge!`, any entries written into the Hash via `I18n.fallbacks[locale] = ...` or `merge!` would be stored in the underlying Hash but never returned by `[]`, meaning externally configured fallback mappings would be silently ignored.
